{{Top|leg}}
'''Gyro-locks''' were components installed on the [[Aquadon CAVa 400]] which featured a [[Gyroscopic stabilizer|gyroscopically stabilized]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. In the event of heavy damage, the gyro-locks could release the cockpit from the craft.
